models_evaluated: AI model for thyroid nodule ultrasound (unnamed)

links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic accuracy with versus without AI assistance in intermediate suspicion nodules
links.effect: Radiologists' accuracy rose from 66.4%-71.4% without AI to 74.1%-79.4% with AI across three guidelines (P < .001).
links.quote: Radiologists' overall accuracy increased from 66.4% to 71.4% without AI to 74.1% to 79.4% with AI across all three guidelines (P < .001).

links.outcome: Clinician performance and FNA decisions when using AI versus without AI
links.effect: AI assistance reduced FNA rates by 20.3% to 34.7%, increased malignant detection by 15.0% to 23.4%, decreased missed malignancy by 23.7% to 36.8% (all P < .001).
links.quote: AI assistance reduced FNA rates by 20.3% to 34.7%, increased malignant detection rate by 15.0% to 23.4%, and decreased missed malignancy rate by 23.7% to 36.8% (all P < .001).
